ElementDescription: The NDAR Global Unique Identifier (GUID) for research subject
Subject ID how it's defined in lab/project
Date on which the interview/genetic test/sampling/imaging/biospecimen was completed. MM/DD/YYYY
Age in months at the time of the interview/test/sampling/imaging.
Notes: Age is rounded to chronological month. If the research participant is 15-days-old at time of interview, the appropriate value would be 0 months. If the participant is 16-days-old, the value would be 1 month.

ElementDescription: Sex of subject at birth
Notes: M = Male; F = Female; O=Other; NR = Not reported

ElementDescription: Are there times when s/he is very still for long periods of time, almost like a statue?
Notes: 0=No, never; 1=No, not at the moment but it used to happen; 2=Yes, but less than before; 3=Yes, the same as before; 4=Yes, more than before

ElementDescription: How often does the individual experience these periods of freezing/very still like a statue at the moment?
Notes: 1=Rarely when they are awake; 2=Some of the time they are awake; 3= Most of the time they are awake; 4= All or almost all of the time they are awake

ElementDescription: How severely does the individual experience these periods of freezing / very still like a statue at the moment?
